title: Quantum algorithms for second-order boundary value problems
summary: Second-order boundary value problems are central to computational science, yet standard matrix-based numerical formulations can obscure the local geometric structure that quantum circuits may exploit. Here we introduce a framework for explicitly constructing finite-dimensional counterparts of continuous differential operators in a form compatible with quantum computation. Starting from the exterior derivative, its adjoint, and the Hodge operator, we derive discrete realizations of second-order operators on primal--dual cell complexes and reformulate them as star-local update rules expressed…
